Subject: Action Required: Invoice MA-8014 on Hold – PO-2026-1014

Dear Accounts Receivable Team,

Our reference: PO-2026-1014

Your invoice MA-8014 dated October 7, 2026, totaling USD 1,280.00, is currently on hold due to the following discrepancies:

- The invoice currency differs from the purchase order.
- The quantity or unit price for line TAV-180 is unreadable.
- The invoice is issued in USD, while the vendor master for Milano Arredi S.r.l. lists EUR.

Please confirm the correct currency for this transaction—EUR or USD—and provide the quantity and unit price for line TAV-180 on invoice MA-8014.

Please also issue a credit note or a corrected invoice reflecting the confirmed currency and complete line-item details.

Kind regards,
